decisive_items: exocytosis of atypical lymphocytes into the epithelium
CD4 to CD8 cells ratio within hair follicles > 7:1
monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement was demonstrated
response.rationale: The combination of atypical lymphocytes with epidermotropism, follicular involvement, CD4 predominance, and clonal T-cell rearrangement is diagnostic of mycosis fungoides, more specific than the broader CTCL label. Follicular mucinosis is a histologic feature often associated with MF but not sufficient alone.

rejected.why: Follicular mucin deposition is present but is a secondary finding; lacks the atypical lymphocytic infiltrate and clonality that define MF.
Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is a broad category; the specific features point to mycosis fungoides, which is the precise diagnosis.
